claim_boundary.zh: 本工具包只提供可执行空表、字段定义、证据要求和停线逻辑，不构成现场调查、任命接受、报价预算、采购决定、专业审查、授权、复演结果、签署或实施证明。
claim_boundary.en: This kit provides executable blank forms, field definitions, evidence requirements, and stop logic only. It is not evidence of a site survey, accepted appointment, quote, budget, procurement decision, professional review, authorization, rehearsal result, sign-off, or implementation.

blank_value_policy.zh: 所有待外部责任主体填写的初始值均为 null。若现场确实无法获知，可在执行副本中填 unknown，并同时记录原因、责任人、处置和复核；不得把 unknown 当作通过。
blank_value_policy.en: Every field to be completed by an external accountable party starts as null. If a value is genuinely unavailable in an executed copy, unknown may be entered only with its reason, owner, disposition, and review; unknown never means pass.

synthetic_fixture_policy.zh: 如以后增加合成示例，必须逐条标记 synthetic_fixture_not_observed，并从现场样本量、实测值、通过率、成本和实施指标中排除。
synthetic_fixture_policy.en: Any future synthetic example must be marked synthetic_fixture_not_observed and excluded from field sample, observed-value, pass-rate, cost, and implementation metrics.

execution_rules.zh: 先复制空表形成带版本的执行记录；不得覆盖本空白母版。
execution_rules.en: Create a versioned execution record from the blank form; never overwrite this blank master.

execution_rules.zh: 凡涉及权利、安全、预算、采购或开放的字段，缺失、过期或矛盾即保持 HOLD 或 STOP。
execution_rules.en: A missing, expired, or contradictory rights, safety, budget, procurement, or release field keeps the gate at HOLD or STOP.

execution_rules.zh: 外部事实必须附可归属来源、日期、权利等级、独立复核和处置；设计引用不得替代现场证据。
execution_rules.en: External facts require an attributable source, date, rights class, independent review, and disposition; design references cannot substitute for field evidence.

common_record_fields.zh: 独立复核人及利益冲突说明

forms.title_zh: 候选载体现场调查与证据请求表
forms.title_en: Candidate Carrier Survey and Evidence Request
forms.completion_rule_zh: 测量、权属、许可、照片权利、消防、无障碍和专业复核均须有可核验来源；任一关键项缺失即不得进入现场安装。
forms.completion_rule_en: Measurements, control, permission, image rights, life safety, accessibility, and professional review require verifiable sources; a missing critical item blocks site installation.

fields.zh: 实测无障碍服务位置数
所有权人或场地控制主体
照片采集与公开权利索引
fields.en: Photo capture and publication rights reference

forms.title_zh: 责任接受、授权边界与利益冲突表
forms.title_en: Responsibility Acceptance, Authority Boundary, and Conflict Form
forms.completion_rule_zh: 每一 H0—H4 决策角色及必要会签角色均须明确接受职责、权限和服务覆盖；静默、邮件抄送或职务推定不构成接受。
forms.completion_rule_en: Every H0-H4 decision role and required cosignatory must explicitly accept duties, authority, and service coverage; silence, copied email, or inferred office does not constitute acceptance.

forms.title_zh: D0 观察记录、数据字典与缺失处置表
forms.title_en: D0 Observation Record, Data Dictionary, and Missingness Form
forms.completion_rule_zh: 一行只记录一个有效任务会话；不得记录直接身份标识。缺失、退出或失败均保留，不得从分母静默删除。
forms.completion_rule_en: Each row records one valid task session and excludes direct identifiers. Missing, withdrawn, and failed observations are retained and never silently removed from the denominator.

fields.zh: 同意或合法处理依据索引
直接身份标识排除确认
申诉或拒绝路径是否主动提供
fields.en: Appeal or refusal path proactively offered

fields.zh: 退出与普通服务恢复结果

forms.title_zh: 工程量、成本基准与非约束采购包表
forms.title_en: Quantity, Cost Basis, and Non-binding Procurement Pack Form
forms.completion_rule_zh: 设计测试数量不得冒充实测工程量；价格必须可追溯并按同一范围、地区、日期、币种和税口径归一化。采购路线、预算、供应商与授标在授权前保持空白。
forms.completion_rule_en: Design-test quantities cannot stand in for measured quantities. Prices must be traceable and normalized to a common scope, location, date, currency, and tax basis. Route, budget, supplier, and award remain blank before authorization.

fields.zh: 归一化含税单价（人民币）
经核验项目金额（人民币）
数据、知识产权与可携带性条款
评估独立性与利益冲突隔离

forms.title_zh: 专业复核、门槛证书与验收记录
forms.title_en: Professional Review, Gate Certificate, and Acceptance Record
forms.completion_rule_zh: 专业意见、阈值测试、门槛决定和授权范围必须可追溯；涉及基本权利、生命安全、隐私、人工接管或退出恢复的关键项不得豁免。
forms.completion_rule_en: Professional opinion, threshold testing, gate decision, and authorized scope must be traceable. Critical rights, life-safety, privacy, human-takeover, and exit-restoration items cannot be waived.

forms.title_zh: 复演、维护与退出交接记录
forms.title_en: Rehearsal, Maintenance, and Exit Handover Record
forms.completion_rule_zh: 四类事件须分别复演并保留版本、触发、步骤、证据、偏差与重试；任何关键失败均保持暂停。退出必须同时证明数据、资产、未结案件和普通服务恢复。
forms.completion_rule_en: Each of the four events is rehearsed separately with version, trigger, steps, evidence, deviation, and retest records. Any critical failure keeps release on hold. Exit must cover data, assets, open cases, and ordinary-service restoration.

fields.zh: 见证独立性与利益冲突
退出触发与 ALT01—ALT04 索引

forms.title_zh: 参考进度、RAID 与变更控制台账
forms.title_en: Reference Programme, RAID, and Change-control Register
forms.completion_rule_zh: 参考窗口和持续时间只用于依赖审查，不是承诺工期。实际日期、责任主体、风险状态、决定和变更批准必须在授权后由相应责任人填写。
forms.completion_rule_en: Reference windows and durations support dependency review and are not programme commitments. Actual dates, accountable parties, risk status, decisions, and change approvals are completed by authorized parties only.

fields.zh: 投稿方参考持续时间范围

sections.title_zh: 风险、假设、问题、决定与变更
sections.title_en: Risk, assumption, issue, decision, and change
